title: Cross-functional handover and skill snapshot template (21-day)
content:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, cross-functional handover + skill snapshot template intended for new hires and managers to run in the first 21 days. The goal is to standardize what gets transferred (context, systems, contacts), what to observe (signals, risk flags), and a minimal rubric to quickly assess readiness for independent contributions. Use as a fillable working doc during the first 3 weeks — copy into the hire's private doc and iterate with the hiring manager, mentor, and cross-functional partners.

How to use (quick):
- Copy the doc into the new hire's onboarding folder within Day 0 (Link to Day0 checklist).
- Manager schedules three 30–45m checkpoints: Day 3 (orientation alignment), Day 10 (early blockers + skill snapshot), Day 21 (handover complete + go/no-go readiness).
- Invite primary peers from infra/platform, product, and owners of dependent services for the Day 21 sync.
- Complete the rubric and attach links to observed artifacts (PRs, tickets, notes).

Sections (fill these in during 0–21d):
1) Role elevator and scope (manager):
- One-line role statement: what independence looks like at 30/60/90.
- Top 3 deliverables in first 90 days.
- Key systems & repos (list minimal access needed).

2) Contacts & escalation map (practical):
- Team mentor: name + calendar link.
- On-call buddy (if applicable).
- Cross-functional points: infra-owner, product PM, SRE liaison.
- Escalation threshold (e.g., service-impacting > page): who to page and when.

3) Minimum access checklist (manager/eng):
- GitHub repo read/write to: repo-1, repo-2
- CI/CD pipeline access (CI service name)
- Internal docs & Confluence: product-root, infra-runbook
- Slack channels: #team, #oncall, #infra-alerts
- Cloud console (scoped role) or Sandbox environment access
- Security checklist: SSO, 2FA, KMS read-only (if needed)

4) 21-day task list (practical, prioritized):
- Day 0–3: environment setup, run local app, run test suite, join team standup
- Day 4–10: shadow code review, fix a small bug, attend product deep-dive, complete one small infra workflow runbook
- Day 11–18: deliver a small scoped change (feature flag flip, config tweak), own rollout with mentoring, document the steps taken
- Day 19–21: prepare and run cross-functional handoff demo; update runbooks and tag owner(s)

5) Skill snapshot (manager + mentor observation) — quick scales (1–4):
- System comprehension: 1 (no context) — 4 (can explain end-to-end)
- Codebase fluency: 1 (needs heavy guidance) — 4 (confident small-to-medium PRs)
- Debugging efficiency: 1 (slow or blocked) — 4 (diagnose & propose fix)
- Config & infra ops: 1 (needs help) — 4 (independent ops run)
- Cross-team communication: 1 (requires structure) — 4 (proactively coordinates)
- Documentation & knowledge sharing: 1 (none) — 4 (updates runbooks + how-tos)

Notes on scoring: use evidence (PR links, tickets, demo recording) next to each score. If a score is 1 or 2, add explicit remediation steps and owner.

6) Interview-to-onboard continuity (signals to watch):
- Promises vs. reality: did the candidate claim experience that isn't translating? list exact areas.
- Knowledge gaps surfaced in first debugging tasks (e.g., lack of async debugging, unfamiliar with our build system).
- Culture/communication: ability to ask clarifying q's and incorporate feedback.
- Motivation alignment: are goals consistent with role? (If diverging, manager + HR sync recommended.)

7) Risk register (triageable items):
- Access delays: timeline and mitigation owner (example: no cloud access by day 3 -> escalate to infra owner).
- Critical skill delta: if more than two rubric items scored <=2 at day 10, schedule focused 1:1 weekly coaching + specific micro-assignments.
- Behavioral or collaboration concerns: note specific incidents, date/time, and witnesses; escalate per People Ops policy.

8) Handover demo template (Day 21):
- 10m: quick role elevator and 90-day plan
- 15m: live walkthrough of a recent change (link PR or ticket) — context, approach, outcome
- 10m: operational runbook update walk-through (where to find, how to run)
- 10m: Q&A from stakeholders + acceptance checklist signoff

9) Acceptance criteria & signoff (explicit):
- Minimum acceptance: 2/4 for System comprehension AND Codebase fluency OR documented remediation plan with dates + mentor commits to sessions.
- Operational acceptance: can run a basic playbook or rollback in sandbox independently OR partner-runbook demonstrated.
- Cross-functional acceptance: at least one cross-team stakeholder (PM/infra/SRE) thumbs up or recorded feedback.
- Signoff block (manager, mentor, infra owner names + date) — copy into final hire packet.

10) Remediation plan template (if needed):
- Goal: specify 3 focused outcomes (e.g., improve debugging workflow, learn CI config) with measurable checkpoints at 2w and 4w after day 21.
- Owner(s): manager and mentor names with weekly cadence.
- Resources: suggested courses, internal docs, micro-assignments (list).

Unresolved questions / TODOs (doc working area):
- Should we require a minimum of 2 cross-team demo attendees for acceptance? pros/cons list. @Marcus to propose in PEOPLE-88.
- Add a short checklist for private deployments hires (KMS/HSM access flow) — @Jasdeep to draft.
- Consider a 7-day micro-rubric (fast-fail metric) for contractor/short-term hires.

Examples / evidence (fill in during onboarding):
- PR: repo-1/pull/432 — small fix implementing config validation (link)
- Ticket: TICKET-1192 — replicated flaky test locally and proposed fix (link)
- Notes: Day10-debugging-sessions.md (summarize what was blocked and how resolved)

Manager tips (practical):
- Meet daily for first 3 days for 15m; after that move to cadence in the file.
- Make mentor pairing explicit: set 2–3 short missions for mentor/new hire to collaborate on.
- Avoid overwhelming with long reading lists on Day 0; prioritize runnable tasks that return visible feedback.

Why this differs from other onboarding docs:
- Focused on rapid cross-team handover plus measurable skill snapshot at 21 days (not a generic 30/60/90) so teams can make faster readouts for capacity planning and staffing decisions.
- Templateized evidence-first rubric to reduce ambiguity in manager/mentor assessments.

Appendix: quick copyable checkboxes (raw) — paste into hire doc:
- [ ] Day0: local dev environment runs
- [ ] Day1: joined team standup and wrote intro post
- [ ] Day3: first small PR created
- [ ] Day7: shadowed an oncall / incident runbook
- [ ] Day14: owned a small rollback or feature toggle flow
- [ ] Day21: handed off demo + signoff from infra/PM

Contact & revision history:
- Owner: Lena Ortiz — lena.ortiz@redwood.com
- Drafted: 2025-07-10 by Lena
- Collaborators: Jasdeep Kaur (people-ops), Marcus Lee (eng-manager), Eve Tan (SRE) — edits 2025-07-22, 2025-07-31
- Next review (planned): 2025-10-01 for consolidation into onboarding framework.

If you use this template, please paste the final filled doc link into JIRA PEOPLE-88 so we can collect a 3-month efficacy signal.
